subject.title: [Security] Permanent System Credentials Eviction Vulnerability in Redaction Registry

question: Should maintainers transfer this report into the private advisory workflow and treat active configuration credentials as pinned for their usable lifetime?
rationale: The eviction mechanism is confirmed, but disclosure handling and acceptable plaintext-retention lifetime are security-boundary decisions owned by the security team.

options.title: Route privately and separate lifetimes
options.body: Privately assess impact and implement bounded durable and transient registration classes with regression coverage.

options.title: Retain the current bounded policy
options.body: Keep recency eviction only if security review proves every supported active credential is refreshed before it can be evicted.

recommendation.title: Route privately and separate lifetimes
recommendation.body: Privately assess impact and implement bounded durable and transient registration classes with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This team owns SECURITY.md and src/secrets and is the appropriate authority for disclosure and retention-boundary decisions.
